understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, which triggers a WIN for the level and ultimately wins the run after all levels are cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level, with actions consisting of directional moves (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) and CLICK. CLICK targeted a specific coordinate and, when valid/unblocked, caused the currently selected piece to relocate to that clicked position; many clicks had no effect when the destination was blocked or otherwise invalid. Obstacles/walls prevented movement/placement, and when multiple selectable pieces existed, selection mattered (you needed to CLICK/select the intended piece and place each one onto a goal tile simultaneously to satisfy the win condition).

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, which triggers a WIN for the level and ultimately wins the run after all levels are cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level, with actions consisting of directional moves (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) and CLICK. CLICK targeted a specific coordinate and, when valid/unblocked, caused the currently selected piece to relocate to that clicked position; many clicks had no effect when the destination was blocked or otherwise invalid. Obstacles/walls prevented movement/placement, and when multiple selectable pieces existed, selection mattered (you needed to CLICK/select the intended piece and place each one onto a goal tile simultaneously to satisfy the win condition).
